title: The status screen tracks two parallel 3-part verse quests with similar wording — 'Verses' (drowned shrine, old watchtower, barrow hall) for the Vale's Hollow King, and 'Old Court Verses' (the ring-ditch, the king's causeway, the mere-stone) for Barrowmere's old court — easy to conflate at a glance since both are '0/3' and both use 'verse' language.
